messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Severity alert: sustained p99 tail latency breach for tenant 'northern-ledger' on cluster nl-west-2. Auto-page: @rachel (oncall). Links: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/northern-ledger?panelId=3

rachel: ACK. I'm looking. p95 ~1.1s, p99 ~6.8s across the serving tier. Streaming connections dropping mid-stream and clients reporting partial responses.

sanjay: Quick metrics dump:
```
cluster: nl-west-2
tenant: northern-ledger
p95: 1100ms
p99: 6800ms
streaming_drop_rate: 12% (baseline 0.6%)
active_streams: 420 (normal 90)
avg_prompt_len: 5600 tokens (spike)
kv_cache_hit: 28% -> 10% under load
shard_cpu: 92% on s1-3
```
Looks like a scheduled overnight job launched and flooded the single-tenant pool.

emily (CS): Confirmed customer ran a monthly reconciliation job that ran in parallel across 20 workers. They didn't realize these jobs hit the inference route directly instead of our batch endpoint. They started ~09:10 UTC.

rachel: Any recent infra changes?

deploy-bot: deploy:nl-serving-config sha=bb44e1 by @infra-bot 2026-03-15T09:00:12Z — no model changes.

sanjay: Logs show many repeated long system prompts — almost identical system token prefixes per request. That suggests hot-keying on system_prompt hashes and excessive KV churn. Also a number of pods show GC spikes.

rachel: Immediate action plan (short half-life mitigations):
- Apply tenant soft-rate-limit: 60 concurrent streams
- Move new requests to fallback pool with larger KV memory (nl-large) for this tenant
- Temporarily block streaming for very-long responses (>8k tokens) and fall back to non-streaming generation
- Spin up 2 hot-shards in nl-west-2 and enable prefetch for top system prompt keys

sanjay: I'll run the quota and orchestration commands.

(Executing)
```
# apply tenant concurrency
kubectl exec -n infra quotactl -- ./set-tenant-limit --tenant northern-ledger --concurrency 60
# create hot shards
orchestratorctl scale --cluster nl-west-2 --pool northern-ledger-hot --replicas 2 --flavor xlarge
```

infra-bot: Action: scaled northern-ledger-hot to 2 replicas (started).

(50s later)

sanjay: Concurrency throttle in place. Active streams dropped from 420 -> 58. Starting traffic reroute to nl-large fallback.

emily (CS): Messaging customer now: telling them we've applied temporary concurrency limits and asking them to pause the reconciliation job until we stabilize.

rachel: Observability update: p95 -> 320ms, p99 -> 980ms, streaming_drop_rate -> 2.1%. Improvement but still above baseline.

sanjay: Canary of fallback routing shows stable performance. However we see increased I/O wait on hot shards due to KV prefetching hitting SSD often. Might need to tune prefetch window.

emily (CS): Customer acknowledges pause. They say they can throttle to 5 workers while we work on long-term fix.

rachel: Good. Longer-term mitigations to propose in postmortem:
- Add tenant-aware job detection and recommend batch API for long bulk imports
- Automated pre-warming for scheduled tenant jobs (time-based scaling)
- Hot-key detection and auto-prefetch of repeated system prompts with persistent in-memory cache for top N keys
- Alert rule for "long-prompt-concentration" > 3% of requests in a tenant

sanjay: For the immediate runbook update I'm adding a step to detect overnight cron bursts and auto-spin hot-shards before concurrency hits SLO breach.

rachel: Anything else for the handoff? I'll remain on-call for 15 more minutes, then hand to sanjay for the RCA and follow-ups.

emily (CS): I'll coordinate with the customer on a safe rerun plan and confirm when they switch to the batch API.

sanjay: Follow-up tasks I'll own:
- Tune LRU + prefetch heuristics for KV store (IR-#4821)
- Add alert and dashboard for "tenant long prompt ratio"
- Evaluate persistent in-memory cache for top system prompts

rachel: Incident summary for paging: cause = tenant-triggered concurrency surge + hot-system-prompt causing KV thrash -> streaming stalls and p99 spikes. Mitigations: tenant throttle, fallback routing to nl-large, hot-shard spin-up, prefetch enabled. Customer impact reduced. Severity lowered to Sev3. Postmortem assigned to sanjay.

incident-bot: Incident moved to status: mitigated. Severity: Sev3. Postmortem due: 2026-03-16 12:00 UTC.

emily (CS): Customer follow-up scheduled for 2026-03-15 11:00 UTC to validate changes.

sanjay: I'll leave this thread with notes and will file the RCA. Logs to review:
```
2026-03-15T09:11:03Z northern-ledger pod-7 stream: drop detected partial=TRUE wait_for_kv=4.2s key=system_prompt_hash_7
2026-03-15T09:12:21Z northern-ledger pod-2 inference: tokens=8600 concurrency=9 request_id=xyz789
```

rachel: Ending active paging. Leaving thread open for comments. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
